title: Implement Profile validation fixtures and explicit human review
goal: Fail closed unless a fresh draft has exact Module configuration fixture coverage and human policy review bindings.
acceptanceCriteria: Validation rejects stale Target/discovery/draft hashes and invalid Profile or Module configuration.
Selected Modules bind exact manifests configurations and registered capability ceilings.
At least one matching positive and negative fixture receipt is required for protected coverage.
Accepted review records bind all identities and explicitly resolve every human policy category and ambiguous Module choice.
risks: A self-authored or stale review could silently convert recommendations into policy.
decisions: Require an external human review record with exact hashes and explicit policy decisions.
